metadata.description: Ismokraft business operating system plugins for product discovery, evaluation, sourcing, testing, launch, and operations.

plugins.name: ads-planning
plugins.description: Domain 2.5 -- Amazon PPC campaign planning, scenario generation, test analysis, anomaly detection. Split from product-testing in DL-022 (size-driven: ads-ops-plan was consuming 67% of product-testing budget).

plugins.name: compliance-management
plugins.description: Product compliance authority -- India cert catalog (BIS, FSSAI, CDSCO, TEC, WPC, etc.), timeline check for Gate 2, certification lifecycle tracking. Split from product-evaluation + product-sourcing + product-testing + product-launch in DL-024 (size-driven: product-launch was at 88% ceiling). Live mode: TIMELINE_CHECK (Gate 2 consumer via test-campaign). Planned stubs: FEASIBILITY (Gate 1), INITIATION (mid-pipeline), COMPLETION (Gate 3) — design preserved in docs/skills/compliance-ops-planned-modes.md.

plugins.name: governance-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture compliance and ecosystem health -- 7-Law enforcement, pattern synthesis, gap detection and routing.

plugins.name: governance-audit
plugins.description: Skill standards compliance -- audit 20 standards (S1-S20), 46+ violation codes, maturity lifecycle, resolution registry.

plugins.name: governance-business
plugins.description: Business decisions and performance measurement -- strategic alignment, GO FEARLESS quality, OKR/KPI governance.

plugins.name: margin-calculation
plugins.description: Unit economics authority -- per-unit profitability for Amazon India and Shopify, 5 modes (ESTIMATE, ACTUAL, COMPARISON, CHANNEL, BREAKEVEN). Split from product-evaluation + product-sourcing in DL-023 (size-driven: both host plugins were at 99% ceiling). Consumed by D1 (ESTIMATE), D2 (ACTUAL), D2.5 COMPARISON at Gate 2, and ad-hoc CHANNEL/BREAKEVEN utility calls.

plugins.name: platform-io
plugins.description: Platform I/O layer -- Zoho read/write/sync across CRM, Bigin, Books, Inventory, Desk, Analytics via MCP.

plugins.name: product-discovery
plugins.description: Domain 1 discovery stages -- keyword intelligence, product discovery, screening, market intelligence.

plugins.name: product-evaluation
plugins.description: Domains 1 + 1.5 -- deep evaluation, competitive positioning. Paired with margin-calculation (DL-023) and compliance-management (DL-024) plugins.

plugins.name: product-launch
plugins.description: Domain 3 -- listing copy, capital planning, bulk fulfillment. Paired with compliance-management plugin (DL-024) for Gate 3 compliance completion.

plugins.name: product-ops
plugins.description: Domain 4 -- live monitoring, ad management, learning engine.

plugins.name: product-sourcing
plugins.description: Domain 2 -- product spec, vendor evaluation. Paired with margin-calculation (DL-023) and compliance-management (DL-024) plugins.

plugins.name: product-testing
plugins.description: Domain 2.5 -- test campaign ops: monitoring, FBA dispatch, Slack messaging. Paired with ads-planning (DL-022) and compliance-management (DL-024) plugins.

plugins.name: revenue-analytics
plugins.description: Revenue health analytics -- sales, settlement reconciliation, returns, forecasting, P&L, marketing efficiency. Read-only.

plugins.name: supplier-research
plugins.description: Supplier intelligence engine -- multi-source discovery, enrichment, verification, classification, 5-dimension ranking for India suppliers.
